relationships.subject: P2X4
relationships.evidence_quote: ATP activation of P2X4R+ reactive microglia evokes the release of brain derived neurotropic factor (BDNF)

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: which in turn downregulates the potassium-chloride cotransporter 2 (KCC2) in spinal laminae I/II neurons

relationships.subject: CB2
relationships.evidence_quote: selective activation of these receptors dampens microglia reactivity and alleviates pain hypersensitivity

relationships.subject: CB2
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with a CB2R agonist reduces P2X4 upregulation in paclitaxel-induced neuropathy

relationships.subject: CB2
relationships.evidence_quote: downregulates the p38 MAP kinase pathway to reduce synthesis of IL-1β, TNF-α and BDNF

relationships.subject: anandamide
relationships.evidence_quote: AEA binds preferentially to CB1R in vitro, but also displays a low binding affinity for transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily V member 1 (TRPV1)

relationships.subject: anandamide
relationships.evidence_quote: endogenous cannabinoids such as AEA may directly block the voltage-gated calcium channel Cav3.2

key_findings: CB2 receptors are upregulated on spinal microglia in chronic pain, and their activation dampens microglial reactivity and pain.
CB2 activation reduces pro-inflammatory cytokines and P2X4 in microglia, counteracting the P2X4-BDNF-KCC2 pathway.
